lines.text: A beast with ten horns and seven heads rises out of the sea, and the dragon gives it power.
The beast's mortal wound is healed, and the whole world follows it and worships the dragon and the beast.
The beast acts for 70 months, speaks blasphemies against God, and is permitted to war against the saints.
A beast from the earth speaks like a dragon and tells people to make a temple for the first beast.
The second beast requires a mark on the right hand or forehead, and the beast's number is 666.
